messages:
alex: Heads-up — trying to promote hotfix-2026.2 to prod in the 14:00 change window, deploy is failing due to deployer role check.

deploy-bot: deploy blocked: missing MFA requirement for user/service-account 'svc-deployer-01'

mira: can someone with deployer-sudo approve? IIRC we have a JIT flow: /request-elev infra-sre

sam: I tried JIT but the portal shows 'no eligible approvers' — sounds like role mapping dropped after the last RBAC sync.

taylor: hmm, we recently tightened MFA so service accounts need short-lived certs. ops can issue a 'sudo-token' for 30m.

alex: can infra team run the token issue? We need to push a patch for a slow memory leak — rollback is riskier.

infra-oncall: FYI — RBAC sync failed at 13:48, retry in progress.

mira: if RBAC sync won't fix fast, option B: update release manifest to pin previous model-server image, run canary then promote. That's safer but slower.

sam: command I ran:
```
./deploy promote hotfix-2026.2 --env prod
Error: unauthorized: require_mfa
```

alex: timeline: we have 35m left in change window. If infra can grant sudo-token in 10m -> proceed. else we do canary pinning.

taylor: @infra-oncall can you approve temporary sudo for alex+sam? Add audit note: 'change window emergency deploy'

infra-oncall: granting 30m sudo to alex, sam. Audit-id: AUD-2100001111-42

alex: got it, proceeding with promote. will post progress.

deploy-bot: promotion started: job#9876

deploy-bot: job#9876 succeeded in canary, promoted global

alex: done. note: update runbook: ensure svc-deployer-01 has mfa mapping to group infra-deployers. filing PR.

mira: thanks. created PR #542 with RBAC mapping change and added test to nightly RBAC sync.
